title: Three search options scored against the team's real constraints
after:

Postgres is the only option with no hard "no" on the top five drivers. Meilisearch fails the on-call constraint, and Algolia hits the cost approval gate. **The answer flips** if typo tolerance turns out to be the main complaint, or if the Postgres production estimate comes in well over Sam's 2 weeks.
caption: From docs/search-decision.md. It recommends Postgres at medium confidence, writes up the dissenting view fairly, and names the two cheap checks that would flip the call before the Oct 20 deadline.
